stock_outlook.thesis_summary: Dividend-supported fundamentals and fair valuation support a neutral outlook with credit-cycle sensitivity.
key_drivers: Dividend yield provides reliable income with resilient business economics
Valuation looks reasonable on core multiples versus ROE
Earnings quality is supported by diversification across banking segments
Credit quality of Canadian mortgages is the primary swing factor

final_recommendation.executive_summary: Royal Bank is a core Canadian holding — hold the position. At fair valuation, the dividend yield provides reliable income, and the moat supports downside resilience. The key variable to monitor is Canadian mortgage credit quality in 2026-27.
final_recommendation.cio_rationale: Low disagreement across all four Pass 2 agents — all converge on 'hold at current price, accumulate on weakness.' I affirm this consensus view.

layer2_context.portfolio_fit_rationale: The dividend-and-moat profile fits a registered-account income sleeve, while timing depends on credit-cycle signals.
layer2_context.suggested_action: Hold the position; consider incremental adds on weakness tied to credit conditions.
